---
title: "Bubbles in Everything"
date: "2005-08-22"
categories: ["Economics"]
---

This Harry Dent Jr title is surely the best evidence yet that the term ‘bubble’ has become so widely abused as to be meaningless:

[Bubble After Bubble in The Ongoing Bubble Boom: Oil Bursts, the Housing Bubble Fades and Now Stocks Emerge Into a Greater Bubble that Finally Ends in 2010](http://www.amazon.com/exec/obidos/tg/detail/-/B000A0F6Q8/ref=ase_institutional-20/002-8730394-7042416?v=glance&s=books "Bubble After Bubble in The Ongoing Bubble Boom: Oil Bursts, the Housing Bubble Fades and Now Stocks Emerge Into a Greater Bubble that Finally Ends in 2010").

This title sells for 49 cents, which is 25 times the two cents this sort of opinion usually sells for.  A Greater Bubble indeed.
